title: The title restyle walk reaches its last Part In dropdown again
goal: The walk that restyles a title with a few knobs fails on its last step: by then the Part In dropdown has scrolled up under the window title bar, so a pointer click on it lands on the title bar instead. Either the panel should keep a clicked row clear of the title bar or the walk should scroll it back into view first.
notes: Reproduced 2026-10-11 on HEAD 0deef2bf with no working changes (sources stashed, probe rebuilt): `Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/title-knobs-restyle-walk.json` -> step 85 (panelMenu): the "Part In" dropdown did not open for a person hand at centre ((1640, 972), the click landed on NSHostingView<...TitlebarPanelToggle...>); face (1566, 960) 148x24. Same failure with the 3D transitions task changes. The row sits under the glass title bar after the Part section grows (Out Rise/Direction/Fade rows).
acceptance: A panel row scrolled under the title bar can still be clicked open, or the walk reveals the row before clicking it

log.note: No longer reproduces: title-knobs-restyle-walk passed in the full sweep that finished 2026-10-12T07:33Z (queue/sweep/2026-10-11-203658.log line 734) and again when the 2026-10-12 triage ran Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/title-knobs-restyle-walk.json --no-build on HEAD 09b3ec12: all 95 steps, 11 real pictures, walk complete.
